summary_en: This study tests whether adding tremelimumab and chemotherapy to durvalumab, with treatment guided by a blood test for circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), can help in stage III or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Patients with detectable ctDNA receive 4 cycles of chemotherapy with tremelimumab and durvalumab every 21 days, then durvalumab to complete 1 year, while patients with undetectable ctDNA receive durvalumab alone. The record does not state a main outcome measure; its stated goal is to see whether circulating cancer cells in the blood can be decreased, and the study is Phase 3.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa si agregar tremelimumab y quimioterapia a durvalumab, con un tratamiento guiado por un examen de sangre para el ADN tumoral circulante (ctDNA), puede ayudar en el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas (CPCNP) en estadio III o recurrente. Los pacientes con ctDNA detectable reciben 4 ciclos de quimioterapia con tremelimumab y durvalumab cada 21 días, y luego durvalumab hasta completar 1 año, mientras que los pacientes con ctDNA no detectable reciben solo durvalumab. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; su objetivo declarado es ver si pueden disminuir las células cancerosas circulantes en la sangre, y el estudio es de Fase 3.
who_for: Stage III or recurrent NSCLC treated earlier with platinum chemotherapy and radiation, with no known progression.
Currently receiving consolidation durvalumab, with less than 32 weeks since the first dose.
Age 18 or older and weight over 30 kg.
Adequate blood counts, kidney and liver function, and a tumor sample believed to be available.
not_for: Mixed small cell and non-small cell lung cancer histology.
Prior grade 3 or higher immune-related adverse event on immunotherapy, or an unresolved one above grade 1.
Autoimmune or inflammatory disorder likely to limit continuing durvalumab.
Active uncontrolled infection, or active hepatitis B, hepatitis C, tuberculosis or HIV as defined.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or not using effective birth control when required.
